results.name: wake_cost_bench
results.raw_output:
Platform: Linux (futex_wake supports exact K → kWakeAllThreshold = INT_MAX)

Spurious-wake round-trip: 43968 ns

Producer-side wake costs (avg over 200 trials):
    N |     wake-1 |   wake-all | K threshold (wake-all wins for K >=)
------+------------+------------+------------------------------------
    2 |    20118 ns |    31900 ns | 2
    3 |    20012 ns |    48514 ns | 3
    4 |    17885 ns |    79145 ns | 5
    6 |    29743 ns |   133122 ns | 5

Guidance:
- For each group size G in production, look up the row N=G above.
- The 'K threshold' column tells you: for wake-K calls with K below
  this value, the loop wake-one path is cheaper. For K >= threshold,
  the wake-all path is cheaper (ignoring spurious-wake CPU cost,
  which is bounded by spurious-round-trip * (G - K) and runs in
  parallel on idle cores).
- Set DISPENSO_TUNE_WAKE_ALL_THRESHOLD to the threshold value for
  your default group size on this platform.
